rounds.title: Round 1: Lateral Connections
rounds.subtitle: Standard 2-Clue Pinning — Every prompt gives you two angles to deduce a famous answer.

config.clue1: Its national flag is the only sovereign flag in the world that is not a four-sided rectangle, instead using two stacked pennants.
config.clue2: Located in the Himalayas, it is home to eight of the world's ten tallest mountains, including Mount Everest.
config.funFact: The two triangles represent the Himalayas and the two major religions of the country: Hinduism and Buddhism.
config.question: Which Asian country is this?

config.clue1: In the 1830s, Dr. John Cook Bennett promoted this everyday table item as a concentrated patent medicine sold in pill form to cure indigestion.
config.clue2: Originally made in Asia from fermented fish brine ('koe-chiap'), it was transformed in 1876 by Henry J. Heinz using ripe red tomatoes and vinegar.
config.funFact: Wait times for pouring glass bottles of Heinz ketchup are governed by non-Newtonian shear-thinning fluid dynamics!
config.question: What ubiquitous condiment is this?

config.clue1: Patented in 1904 by feminist Georgist activist Elizabeth Magie as 'The Landlord's Game', it was originally designed to demonstrate how untaxed land monopolies bankrupt tenants.
config.clue2: After Parker Brothers bought the rights in the 1930s, its street names were permanently modeled after neighborhoods in Atlantic City, New Jersey.
config.funFact: Magie's original game actually had two rule sets: 'Prosperity' (where everyone won when land value rose) and 'Monopolist' (where one player bankrupted everyone).
config.question: What classic board game is this?

config.clue1: It was the same calendar year that the British Empire officially handed sovereignty of Hong Kong back to China AND IBM's Deep Blue defeated Garry Kasparov.
config.clue2: In cinemas that year, James Cameron's 'Titanic' began its record-shattering box office run, while the first 'Harry Potter' book was published in the UK.
config.funFact: July 1, 1997 marked the Hong Kong handover; Deep Blue beat Kasparov in May 1997; Titanic released in December 1997.
config.question: What exact calendar year connects all four of these events?
